institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: DA-EPOCH-R (dose-adjusted etoposide/prednisone/vincristine/cyclophosphamide/doxorubicin + rituximab)

premedications.name: Rituximab premedication
premedications.notes: acetaminophen + antihistamine before each rituximab infusion

premedications.name: Tumor-lysis prophylaxis
premedications.notes: hydration + allopurinol (rasburicase if high burden) for cycle 1

supportiveCare: G-CSF from day 6 of every cycle (mandatory - this is a dose-intense infusional regimen)
Central venous access for the 96-hour continuous infusion
PJP and antiviral prophylaxis; check hepatitis B before rituximab
monitoring: CBC twice weekly to find the nadir - the etoposide/doxorubicin/cyclophosphamide doses are escalated one level each cycle if the prior-cycle nadir ANC stayed above 500
CNS prophylaxis given the high CNS-relapse risk of high-grade disease

drugs.name: Rituximab
drugs.notes: 375 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of each 21-day cycle (given before the infusional block).

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: 50 mg/m2 per day by continuous IV infusion, days 1-4 (96 h). Dose-level 1 baseline; escalate per nadir counts.

drugs.name: Vincristine
drugs.notes: 0.4 mg/m2 per day by continuous IV infusion, days 1-4. No 2 mg cap in EPOCH (infusional schedule).

drugs.name: Doxorubicin
drugs.notes: 10 mg/m2 per day by continuous IV infusion, days 1-4. Track cumulative anthracycline exposure.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: 750 mg/m2 IV bolus on day 5 (dose-level 1 baseline; escalate/de-escalate per nadir counts).
